name: pyinfra-canonical
instr:
The repository at `/workdir` is pyinfra, a Python tool that turns Python code into shell commands and runs
them on servers: operations describe the desired state of a host and generate the shell commands needed to
reach it, and facts run commands on a host and parse their output into Python data that operations use to
decide what to do. It ships with connectors for SSH, the local machine, Docker and a `@fake` connector that
simulates execution without a real host.

Fix all implementation drift from the documentation in this repository.
Everything in scope is the pyinfra operations and facts packages under src/pyinfra/operations/ and src/pyinfra/facts/ (including their util and freebsd subpackages), together with docs/operations.md, docs/facts.md, docs/api/operations.md and docs/api/facts.md, and the module, class and function docstrings of the in-scope modules.

Where the code and the documentation disagree about runtime behavior, the documentation is the
authority: change the implementation so that it does what the documentation says, and do not edit
or delete documentation to make a disagreement go away. The documentation is those pages and the
in-package docstrings, including their examples; in-package code comments are only supporting
evidence, and when a comment conflicts with the documentation, follow the documentation.

The environment runs Python 3.11 with pyinfra's dependencies and the upstream operation and fact test
harness pyinfra-testing installed, and has no net
